top_signals.title: Bajaj Finance Said Set to Launch Up to $1.2 Billion Share Sale
top_signals.summary: Bajaj Finance Ltd. is set to launch a share sale to raise as much as 117 billion rupees ($1.2 billion) from institutional investors as soon as this week in Mumbai, according to people familiar with the matter, in what would be the first major Indian equity offering since Jio Platforms Ltd.’s record $3.1 billion initial public offering last month.

Activities of U.S. Affiliates of Foreign Multinational Enterprises, 2024
top_signals.summary: Majority-owned U.S. affiliates of foreign multinational enterprises employed 8.57 million workers in the United States in 2024, a 0.2 percent increase from 8.56 million workers in 2023, according to statistics on U.S. affiliate operations and finances released today by the U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis.
